description: Safety Korea disaster information portal (safekorea.go.kr) is a data portal run by Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Korea. The official disaster-safety portal carries disaster messages, shelter locations, hazard-zone maps and citizen action guides of the national emergency management authority. Coverage: South Korea. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html, api; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. It can support shelter and emergency-response studies of Korea. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
